concurrentBatchesConfirm.title: Confirm increasing concurrent batches
concurrentBatchesConfirm.bodyChange: Concurrent batches will increase from {from} to {to} ({from} → {to})
concurrentBatchesConfirm.bodyCostWarning: Increasing concurrent batches sends more LLM API requests at once, which directly raises cost with paid providers.
concurrentBatchesConfirm.bodyLocalWarning: For local models, increasing concurrent batches can also cause OOM or severe slowdowns.

general.weatherLocationHelp: The calendar shows Open-Meteo weather forecasts for this location.
general.simpleModeHelp: Keep Assistant, Timeline, Tasks, Notifications (including voice reminders), Settings / AI Settings, and Logs. Hide Monitor, Sources, Intelligence map, and Leaderboard — for calendar scheduling without multi-source collect/analyze.
general.weatherLocationAutoHelp: Infers your city from the OS timezone; uncheck to specify a city or region.
general.weatherLocationRequired: Enter a location name, or choose Follow system
general.collectorRestartDescription: Restarts the message collector and reconnects all source adapters. Does not delete the database or account sessions.
general.collectorRestartConfirmBody: This will disconnect and reconnect all source adapters (Telegram, Discord, Email, RSS, etc.). Messages and account data are not deleted.
general.appVersionHelp: Shared semver for frontend and backend (repo-root VERSION); DEV prefix in dev mode.
general.databaseVersionHelp: Public schema SemVer (same shape as app version). The internal SQLite stamp is a wipe-only integer baseline; mismatched stamps require a database reset (no migration upgrade path).
general.lanAccessHelp: Bind the local server to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) so other devices on your LAN can connect as remote clients. Default is loopback-only (127.0.0.1). Changing this restarts the app. For internet / port-forward access, put Caddy or Nginx TLS in front — the app does not terminate HTTPS.

debug.rulesVersionHelp: Version string written into message-batch prompts (event / leaderboard system prompts), e.g. v2, so you can correlate prompt revisions. Does not change evidence style, scheduling, or analysis rules. Leave empty to omit the tag. Unused by web intel / project / recurring. Saves on blur or Enter.
debug.traceVerboseHelp: Write more detailed analysis tracing to server logs (not the Settings → Logs page). Takes effect immediately when toggled.

theme.bgQuotaExceeded: Not enough localStorage space to save the background image
theme.bgImageHelp: Available on every theme. Custom photos pause page texture until removed.
theme.colorOpacityHelp: Each swatch has its own color and opacity. Lowering card opacity also softens glass menus.
theme.resetPersonalizationHelp: Clears color, opacity, and texture overrides for this theme. Does not remove a custom background image.

retention.helpAnalysis: Includes Key Events and calendar (same Event data).
retention.helpAppLogs: Shorter by default; set to 0 to disable auto cleanup.
retention.invalid: Retention days must be 0 or a positive integer (0 = disable auto cleanup)
retention.description: Each data type has its own retention days; set to 0 to disable cleanup for that type. A background job runs daily, or use “Run now” below. Deleting old messages does not cascade-delete completed analysis results.

data.retentionCleanupDescription: Runs a cleanup pass immediately using the current retention days, and returns the deleted counts per category. Does not restart the service.
data.retentionRunConfirmBody: This deletes expired messages, analysis results, leaderboard rows, logs, and user events per the current retention days. This cannot be undone.
data.runtimeResetDescription: Deletes all local state (database, admin account, secret.key, Desktop connection.json, device/Telegram sessions, and frontend cache), relaunches Desktop / reloads the page, and opens first-run setup.
data.runtimeResetConfirmBody: This deletes the database, secret.key, connection.json, admin account, account sessions, and frontend cache, then relaunches into first-run setup. This cannot be undone.

webSearch.braveKeyHelp: From the Brave console; search fails if empty.

llm.thinkingModeHelp: Off by default (think=false). If you still see reasoning text, use an instruct model.

voice.sttHelp: Hides the mic when unavailable; typing still works.
voice.sttHelpDesktopBlocked: Desktop does not support browser speech recognition—please type instead.
voice.ttsHelp: Can read replies aloud; stop anytime on the assistant page.
voice.spacePttHelp: Hold = hold Space to talk; toggle = press to start/stop. Mic follows this.
voice.spacePttHelpDesktopBlocked: STT unavailable here; Space talk won’t run yet.
voice.ttsVoiceHelp: Local = offline; online needs network. Affects read-aloud only, not STT.
voice.ttsPreviewFailed: Preview failed. Check browser speech or system volume.

voice.defaultWorksetHelp: Default workset for assistant-created events (full page, quick dialog, and Space PTT share this). Default is the builtin General workset.

analysis.loadError: Could not load analysis scheduling settings
analysis.triggerThresholdHelp: Start a new batch once unanalyzed messages reach this count. Default 50. Event/leaderboard tasks may override on the task form.
analysis.batchLimitHelp: Max messages per batch; once triggered, fill the batch up to this cap. Default 50. Event/leaderboard tasks may override on the task form.
analysis.evidenceStyleHelpSuffix: How strict to be about emitting intel and evidence. Tasks may override on the task form.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Looser bar: more leads, still needs message support

analysis.autoPauseHelp: Pause after repeated failures to avoid infinite retries.

advanced.timeoutHelp: Max wait per LLM call; hard timeout ≈ 2× then retry.
advanced.maxRetriesHelp: Retries per failed batch; exhaustion can auto-pause.
advanced.maxConcurrentHelpOllama: Recommend 1; local models dislike high concurrency.
advanced.maxConcurrentHelpCloud: Recommend 3; cloud APIs can run in parallel.
advanced.maxConcurrentError: Local models may not handle this; lower it.
advanced.maxCharsHelp: Raw-content cap per batch; truncate early past this.
advanced.maxTokensHelp: Shared input-token ceiling; lower if long content fails often.

apiDocs.intro: Local HTTP API docs and examples: access keys, Webhook ingest, and Account manager (A2A); plus Desktop calendar deep links. Full contract: docs/agent/a2a.md in the repo.

accessKeys.title: Access keys
accessKeys.body: Call automation APIs with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Full keys (`*`) work for Webhook and Account manager; Account-manager-only keys can only call `/api/v1/a2a/*`. Not for UI sign-in.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.body: `POST /api/v1/messages` requires a full key (`*`). Account-manager-only keys cannot ingest. `metadata` is optional and only helps the AI understand source context.

liaison.title: Account manager (A2A)
liaison.body: `POST /api/v1/a2a/agent`: assign work in natural language (for OpenClaw / Hermes, etc.). Shares the assistant’s LLM + tools; the server loops tools internally and returns one shot — final message plus tool summary. No server-side chat history (callers may keep their own). Needs an AI provider and an Account-manager key (or `*`).
capabilities: Natural-language in; single response with message + toolCalls
Messages / intel / calendar (create/update/delete events)
No custom events schema for third-party agents
liaison.exampleInput: What's on the calendar tomorrow, and create a family meeting Friday afternoon
liaison.exampleMessage: No meetings tomorrow. Created Friday family meeting.
liaison.docsHint: Full contract: docs/agent/a2a.md in the repo.

deepLink.title: Desktop calendar deep link
deepLink.body: Packaged Desktop only (not an HTTP API). The app registers `intelligencemonitor://` and `.ics` file association. Opening a link or file shows the add-to-calendar / pick-workset dialog; confirming uses batch preview/commit via `/api/v1/calendar/imports/*`. Not webcal/CalDAV sync.
capabilities: `intelligencemonitor://calendar/import?url=…` — fetch remote ICS (http/https)
`title` + `start` required for inline drafts; optional `end` / `location` / `body` / `worksetId`
Or open a `.ics` file from the OS (same confirmation dialog)
deepLink.docsHint: Details: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Desktop calendar import) and docs/KNOWN-SIMPLIFICATIONS.md in the repo.

staff.title: AI staff
staff.intro: Five AI staff: two front-line chats, three back-office (leaderboard / key events / project manager). Plus an Account manager who greets external systems (same team as the assistant; no chat with you).
staff.backofficeNote: Back-office staff are invoked by analysis tasks; they don’t appear in chat.
staff.displayNameHelp: Leave blank to use the default name.
staff.avatarTooLarge: Image is still too large after compression. Try a smaller file.
staff.llmProviderHelp: Uses that provider’s saved base URL, model, and API key from AI provider settings.
staff.historyMaxMessagesHelp: Max recent dialogue messages sent to the model (system prompt excluded from the count). Older turns are omitted when exceeded; the UI transcript stays complete. Default 40.
staff.historyMaxCharsHelp: Approx. max characters for the model-facing history (including the system prompt). Older turns are omitted when exceeded. Default 48000.

assistant.summary: A multi-turn Agent that can look up data or create schedule items when needed.
capabilities: Answer questions about local intel and schedules in natural language
Search collected messages
List / create / update / delete user events (one-off calendar items)
Create / update / delete recurring schedules (schedule-clerk RRULE tasks)
Optionally search the web when enabled in settings
Works in the assistant popup and full assistant page; voice in/out optional

taskEditor.summary: Chats beside new/edit task forms to help fill settings (not an Agent).
capabilities: Suggest task name and description from what you want to monitor
Suggest task type (leaderboard / key events / web intel / recurring / project) and prompt direction
Help with time range, search query, and schedule-related fields
Only configures tasks—does not analyze messages or call tools

leaderboard.summary: Back-office: batch-processes messages into trending topics.
capabilities: Extract discussion topics from a message batch
Score relevance/heat and summarize topics
Update the leaderboard for the leaderboard page
No chat UI; triggered by schedules or manual task runs

eventIntel.summary: Back-office: extracts trackable intel and schedule events (including time-inference templates).
capabilities: Extract intel, meetings, activities, deadlines, and similar events
Fill time, place, and people when possible (including relative times)
Results appear in intel / map / timeline views
No chat UI; triggered by schedules or manual task runs

webIntel.summary: Back-office intel gatherer: scheduled web search into analysis events (same store as key events).
capabilities: Run a short search → JSON tick on the task schedule (default hourly)
Uses assistant web-search routing (native OpenAI/Gemini or DDG/Brave tools)
Task prompt describes how to extract events; search query decides what to search
No chat UI; results appear on intelligence / timeline

projectManager.summary: Back-office closed-loop agent: hourly ticks reconcile a project's calendar from sources.
capabilities: Read this project's one-off events and child recurring tasks
Create / update / soft-delete owned calendar items via tools
Ingest incremental messages from bound channels when present
No chat UI; driven by the project task schedule (prefer hourly)

liaison.name: Account manager
liaison.summary: External agent: third parties assign work in natural language—no custom API schema. Doesn’t chat with you.
capabilities: Shares the assistant’s LLM and tools (different system prompt)
Single-shot reply; history kept by the caller if needed
Keys and examples under Settings → API
